description: Figure 8 displays a line plot comparing the accuracy of two experiments, Ex1 and Ex2, during the Embedding and LM Head training stage. The x-axis represents the training step, ranging from 0 to 60,000, with tick marks at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis represents Accuracy (Next Token Prediction), scaled linearly from 0.10 to 0.40. The plot contains two lines: a blue solid line with circular markers representing Ex1 Accuracy, which starts at approximately 0.25 at step 0 and rises to a plateau near 0.40 by step 60,000; and a green dashed line with circular markers representing Ex2 Accuracy, which begins at approximately 0.25 at step 0 and increases to a plateau near 0.35 by step 60,000. Both lines show an initial increase followed by stabilization.
